name: Bee balm

schedule.notes: Surface-sow; needs light to germinate. Cold-moist stratify 2 weeks first for stubborn seed.
Or buy potted divisions — flowers the first year that way.
Cut flowering stems for tea or bouquets. Deadhead to extend bloom into late summer.

harvest.cues: Flowers fully open, ragged tubular blooms in red/pink/purple. Cut whole stems for cutting or tea.
harvest.storageNotes: Hang bundles upside down in shade to dry. Leaves and petals make a citrus-bergamot tea (Oswego tea).

varieties.name: Jacob Cline
varieties.notes: Tall (4 ft), bright red, the most mildew-resistant common variety.

varieties.name: Raspberry Wine
varieties.notes: Wine-red blooms, reliable. Good mildew resistance.

notes: Hummingbird magnet. Spreads by rhizome — divide every 3 years to keep vigorous and limit the patch. Prefers consistent moisture; mildew is worse in dry, crowded plantings. Container-grown plants stay tidy and bloom heavily.
